**Role:** Adjunct Professor (promoted from Graduate Assistant), Montclair State University

## Overview

I developed a machine learning module covering regression and classification for master's students, which led to my promotion from Graduate Assistant to Adjunct Professor.

## What I taught

- Multiple and logistic regression and machine learning in R
- Statistical methods (mean comparison, regression, chi-square) using R and RMarkdown
- Hands-on projects where students applied statistical models to real-world data
